mira: tiny late-night update — launch went live at 00:02 and we crossed 2,016,482 requests in the first 6 hours!! :tada: :rocket:
devon: midnight heroes. absolute chaos but in the best way :raised_hands:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: release v1.14 -> prod at 00:01 (build 789a) | metrics snapshot: 2,016,482 requests | p95=210ms | errors=0.03%
sam: insane. massive props to infra for keeping the p95 steady and to model for the prompt tweak that cut hallucinations
anika: celebration idea: 11:30 kitchen — mini doughnuts, sparkling tea, and a ‘launch confetti’ bag (biodegradable). remote mirror?
louis: i can bring novelty socks for the "most helpful" shoutouts (silly prize). also plant watering duty swap sheet?
ellie: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheers-launch-xyz :party_parrot:
mira: remote folks — we’ll stream the mini-toast and mail tiny care kits. volunteers to pack kits?
taylor: i’ll coordinate shipping labels + a short RSVP sheet
devon: quick poll: exec-facing brag — (1) 1-slide headline or (2) 3-min montage?
sam: 1. keep it short and punchy
anika: tally so far: 5 for 1, 1 for 2
ops-bot: calendar: kitchen reserved 11:30-12:00 by mira. event created.
mira: logistics: setup crew meet at 11:10. volunteers: anika (stream), louis (socks/prizes), sam (doughnuts), ellie (remote DM)
devon: photo concept: everyone bring a silly hat. caption suggestion: "2M Requests, 1 Tiny Hat"
sam: labeling doughnuts: vegan + gluten-free tags. bringing napkins too
ellie: remote care kit RSVP form: https://forms.gle/launch-kit-rsvp (will DM to remote folks)
taylor: reminder: please opt out on the form if you don’t want freebies mailed
mira: small shoutout: infra late-night patch at 23:40, model team for prompt tuning, support for standby — feeling very grateful :heart:
ops-bot: reminder: follow office recycling and food-waste policies when disposing of snacks
devon: virtual toast at 11:35 on #random-video-call. 60s of hype, then back to work :clap:
anika: one last poll: noise-makers? (1) yes (2) no
ellie: 1
louis: 1
mira: 1
devon: 2 (i like quiet celebrations)
sam: 1
anika: tally: 4 yes, 1 no. noise-makers approved — eco-friendly ones only
mira: ok team — see you at 11:30. proud of everyone. small wins stacking to big ones :confetti_ball:
